evidence.mass_and_propeller: User confirmed 81 g and 60 mm for historical hover references.
evidence.primary_logs: Use voltage-era log_ca and log004 as approximate hover anchors. User considers these logs accurate.
evidence.older_logs: Before voltage logging: user considers unreliable; rough qualitative references only, excluded from parameter fitting and acceptance truth.
evidence.thrust: Linear extrapolation from log_ca hover 0.474; not a measured maximum.
evidence.voltage_scaling: Engineering approximation: full-command force proportional to voltage over the training range, not an identified curve.
evidence.motor_response_yaw_drag: Engineering initial values, not identified from the low-rate flight logs.
evidence.sensors: State feedback from simulator; no camera/optical-flow/ToF perception pipeline in this demo.
